howToPlay: Use your basic attack to generate orbiting notes and build up your strength. Then, use your Super to dash toward enemies and finish them off. Keep your distance or engage strategically based on your active notes.
gears: Equip SPEED to maneuver quickly or DAMAGE to increase your impact during fights. SHIELD or HEALTH are excellent choices to improve your survivability while you engage as an assassin.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy aggressive movement and maintaining combat presence with orbiting projectiles.
